BiblicalUsage: In Hebrew, rôchab means width (literally or figuratively). It stands in 1 Kings 4:29, "…God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much…", and in 2 Chronicles 3:3, "…first measure threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that rôchab counts, because God put it in his book.
